claim: On the four-element chain with unit-generated truth filter specified in RESULT.md, the sentence \(\exists x\exists y\,(R(x)\otimes P(y))\) is true in a one-point model and false in a homomorphically related one-point model; four is the minimum source-algebra size for this failure in the fragment generated by \(\exists,\wedge,\vee,\otimes\).
scientific_limitations_integrity: The counterexample uses a four-element nonintegral commutative residuated chain with the truth filter generated by its unit.
The preservation failure concerns existential-positive formulas extended by residuated fusion, not the lattice-only finite homomorphism preservation theorem.
The minimality argument rules out source algebras with fewer than four elements in the stated semantics; it does not classify all finite residuated algebras.
Independent audit has not been performed.
title: A four-element obstruction to existential-fusion preservation
